New Rental Homes in Kerrisdale

FALL SPECIAL: Move in this year and enjoy:

1 Month Free Rent*
$1,000 Move-In Bonus*
Free Wi-Fi Forever*



Welcome to Westward — a brand new rental community at West 49th and Vine in one of Vancouver's most beloved neighbourhoods, Kerrisdale. With homes studios to 3-bedrooms, Westward offers versatile layouts and quality finishes that create the perfect backdrop for modern living. Every home comes with free internet and an air conditioner.

Outside your door, shared indoor and outdoor communal spaces, designed by Ste. Marie Studio, invite you to connect, unwind, and recharge.

Community Amenities include:

Fitness centre
Resident lounges
Co-working space with private word pods
Private dining area
Outdoor terrace with BBQs, lounge areas, lawn games, dog run, playground and shared community garden plots
Pet wash
Bike wash & repair

Steps from vibrant cafés, boutiques, top-rated schools, and parks, Westward puts the best of Kerrisdale within easy reach — with convenient city and campus access when you need it. Pet-friendly and people-focused, this is more than a place to live. It's a community designed to help you thrive.

Westward is now renting, with flexible move-ins. Contact us to book a tour.




*Terms and conditions apply. One-month free rent applies to select homes on a 13-month lease, or a 12-month lease with a valid university/college ID, with the equivalent of one month’s rent applied as free rent at the end of the lease term. Move-in bonus only available for move-ins in 2026. Information contained herein is correct at the time of publication but is subject to change without notice.
